Riya: heads up — onboarding atlas-6b. Quant q4->q8 gave a small eval perf bump but I'm seeing token-level divergence in long-context runs when rotary+KV cache are enabled. Repro on runtime v2.3.1. Attaching short logs and config below.

Mike: can you paste a minimal repro + the exact runtime flags? also which rotary variant (legacy/scaled)?

Riya: repro/config:```
model: atlas-6b
quant: q4_0
rotary_mode: scaled
kv_policy: enable_prefix_cache
seq_len: 2048
runtime: v2.3.1
flags: fused_attn=on, kv_prefetch=1
```
short log snippet:```
[2026-03-19 14:02:13] INFO decode: step=300 prefix_cache_hit=1
[2026-03-19 14:02:14] WARN kv-cache: mismatch detected at step=312 cached_key=0x8f3b computed_key=0x7a2c
[2026-03-19 14:02:14] WARN rotary: phase-shift diff > 1e-3 at head=5 token=312
[2026-03-19 14:02:14] DEBUG decode: fallback_route=enabled
```

Lana: hmm. If disabling prefix cache removes divergence that's a strong signal it's an eviction/order bug. Did you try forcing non-fused attention or different rotary normalization?

Riya: disabling prefix cache removes the mismatch but latency goes +12%. q8 run shows smaller mismatch rates but uses more mem. q4_0 seems most affected when rotary scaling interacts with quantized matmul ordering.

Sam: @Riya can you run with KVCHECK=1 (hash diffs between cached vs recomputed keys) and upload artifacts? Also run the small rouge/wer eval to quantify quality drift.

Riya: kicked off job 1762509997: https://ci.redwood/jobs/atlas6b-kv-check-1762509997 
eng-ci-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/atlas6b/1762509997/kvcache-diffs.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

Mike: likely cause: rotary uses fp16 pre/post-processing that the q4 path bypasses or reorders, leading to different rounding before key projection. We saw similar with sirocco — quick mitigation is pre-normalize rotary angles before quantized matmul or force fp32 in rotary path. Need to verify perf regression.

Riya: filed ML-1182 with repro + artifacts. Marking P1 for bring-up. Proposed next steps: 1) KVCHECK full run across seq lens, 2) reproduce on Dedicated cluster to rule out host GPU variance, 3) test q4_1 and q8 and a fix where rotary pre-normalize is applied, 4) add regression test to model-onboard pipeline and a canary.

Lana: I'll add a canary rollout in runtime that enables kv-check hook and fails deployments if mismatch rate > 0.2%. Sam — can you run throughput/latency for the fallback (prefix disabled) vs fixed-rotary patch?

Sam: on it. ETA ~2h.

Riya: thanks all — linking the ticket and ci artifacts in the ticket, will update once KVCHECK completes. :thumbsup:
